'''Girard''' was a [[human]] who served the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]], holding the rank of [[captain]] and serving as the [[commanding officer]] of the [[cruiser]] ''[[Dawnbringer]]''. 

==Biography==
===Serving the Rebel Alliance===
Captain Girard served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and was a veteran of the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Databank" />

===Serving the New Republic===
After the Rebel Alliance transitioned into the [[New Republic]] following the [[Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Aftermath">[[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']]</ref> in [[4 ABY]] Girard joined the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]] and rose to the rank of [[Captain]]. In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> She led three [[Defender-class cruiser|''Defender''-class cruiser]], including her own ship the ''[[Dawnbringer]]'', to [[Seatos]] on orders from [[Fleet Command (New Republic)|Fleet Command]] to intervene in [[General]] [[Hera Syndulla]]'s [[Incident on Seatos|unauthorized mission]] to Seatos.<ref name="Part Five" />

==Personality and traits==
Girard had little patience for games that might fool a less-seasoned [[soldier]].<ref name="Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
Girard was portrayed by [[Eisa Davis]]<ref name="Part Five Credits">{{Ahsoka|Part Five: Shadow Warrior}} credits</ref> and appeared in the fifth episode of the ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'' television series "[[Part Five: Shadow Warrior]]," that was released on [[September 12]], [[2023]].<ref name="Date">{{SW|url=news/ahsoka-theatrical-event|text=Watch ''Ahsoka'' in Theaters at the Midseason Fan Celebration Event}}</ref>
